name: unipost
description: Schedule, approve, and publish social posts to LinkedIn, X, TikTok, and YouTube, with Instagram coming soon, and see how they performed.

interface.longDescription:
UniPost is a social media scheduler. It connects ChatGPT and Codex to the LinkedIn profiles, X, TikTok, and YouTube accounts you manage. Instagram is coming soon. Ask it to schedule posts with images or video, review what's queued, cancel what you don't need, and see views, likes, comments, and shares for what you've published.

Scheduled posts publish at the time you choose. Turn on approval in UniPost to review each post first, then approve it by saying so in the chat, through a one-click approval link, or in the UniPost dashboard. TikTok posts are always approved in UniPost, where you choose TikTok's privacy and interaction settings, or sent to your TikTok inbox as a draft.

Sign in with your UniPost account the first time you connect, and choose which workspace to use.

positive.prompt: Which social accounts do I have connected in UniPost?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists each connected account's platform and username.

positive.prompt: Schedule 'Testing UniPost from ChatGPT' to the connected AutoFire Demo Motors Facebook Page for tomorrow at 9am Chicago time.
positive.expected_behavior: With approval on (as on the reviewer account), creates the post as waiting for approval, shows it, and asks whether to publish. An approval link is returned too.
After the previous case, approves the pending post so it is scheduled for tomorrow at 9am. Nothing is published before then.

positive.prompt: What's scheduled or waiting for approval this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists posts with their status, time, and destination account.

positive.prompt: How did my posts do over the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows views, likes, comments, and shares by platform plus top posts (zeros for a new account).

negative.description: Unsupported platform: explains UniPost supports LinkedIn profiles, X, TikTok, and YouTube (Instagram coming soon) and schedules nothing.
Direct messages: explains UniPost publishes posts and can't send messages.
negative.prompt: Send a DM to @someone on Instagram.

negative.description: Deleting a published post: explains cancel_post only removes posts that haven't been published, and the post must be deleted on the platform.
negative.prompt: Delete the LinkedIn post I published yesterday.

publication.release_notes: First submission: schedule, approve, cancel, and review posts for LinkedIn profiles, X, TikTok, and YouTube, plus post analytics and X allowance.
